description:
[read-only] The campaign's release-on-product rules, newest first: the product, the phases held, how many posts are waiting, and when and why the rule released (webhook, or already active) or was cancelled.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaigns/builder/{id}/release-on-product.)

brandId.description: Brand to act in. A brand-bound key acts in its own brand (another brandId is 403); an account-wide key defaults to the owner's active brand.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields. For one item in full, use the matching get_ tool.

name: list_campaign_product_releases
title: List a campaign's release-on-product rules
